d: “ TOP 11 MLBB HEROES ADJUSTMENTS ON THE GLOBAL SERVER IN THE CURRENT PATCH 2026. ” 💎 NEW MLBB PATCH IS HERE! 💎 The battlefield is about to change! ⚔️ MOONTON has officially adjusted 11 heroes on the Original/Global Server. 🟢 BUFFED: Argus, Nolan, Aulus, Minsitthar, Esmeralda, Eudora, Melissa 🔻 NERFED: Zhuxin, Baxia, Akai, Fredrinn Will the Tank Jungle meta finally come to an end? 🤔 Or will Fighters and Assassins dominate the Land of Dawn once again? Which adjustment do you think is the biggest game changer? ——— MLBB Original/Global Server Patch – Hero Adjustments This patch focuses on balancing the current meta by reducing the dominance of Tank Junglers while improving the performance of several underutilized Fighters, Mages, and Marksmen. 🔻 Nerfed Heroes Zhuxin – Reduced Skill 2 cast range. Baxia – Lower damage output and slower jungle clear. Akai – Reduced jungle clearing speed, with slightly improved burst damage. Fredrinn – Reduced early-game durability and jungle clear speed. 🟢 Buffed Heroes Argus – Stronger early-to-mid game and laning. Nolan – Improved survivability. Aulus – Better sustain and target sticking. Minsitthar – Lower Ultimate cooldown early game and more serious late-game damage. Esmeralda – Better early-to-mid game presence. Eudora – Reduced mana consumption. Melissa – Reduced mana consumption for smoother laning. Overall Impact This update aims to create a healthier and more diverse hero pool by encouraging more Fighter, Assassin, Mage, and Marksman picks, while reducing the efficiency of Tank and Jungler heroes. ——— MLBB META PREDICTION > ⭐ S-Tier (High Priority Picks) 🟢 Nolan 🟢 Esmeralda 🟢 Melissa 🟢 Argus Reason: These heroes benefit the most from the patch and are expected to have a stronger presence in ranked and competitive play. ⭐ A-Tier (Strong & Reliable) 🟢 Minsitthar 🟢 Aulus 🟢 Eudora 🔻 Fredrinn Reason: They remain effective, with buffs improving consistency or nerfs that are manageable. ⭐ B-Tier (Situational Picks) 🔻 Baxia 🔻 Akai 🔻 Zhuxin Reason: Their nerfs reduce their overall priority, but they can still perform well in the right draft and with experienced players. 🎯 Final Verdict 📈 Biggest Winners 🥇 Nolan 🥈 Esmeralda 🥉 Melissa 🏅 Argus 📉 Biggest Losers ❌ Baxia ❌ Fredrinn (Jungle) ❌ Akai (Jungle) ❌ Zhuxin Prediction: Expect the meta to shift away from Tank Junglers and toward Assassin Junglers, Fighter EXP Laners, and late-game Marksmen, making drafts more flexible and team compositions more diverse. #KBGamingPH #MobileLegendsBangBang #MLBBUpdate #MLBBS41 #MLBBHeroes — @Mobile Legends Philippines 💬 Comment your thoughts below!

d: BEST GENSHIN IMPACT SKINS 31 | #genshinimpact #genshin #геншинимпакт #геншин Genshin Impact — это масштабная многопользовательская ролевая игра с открытым миром, которая переносит игроков в фэнтезийную вселенную Тейвата, где переплетаются магия, судьбы богов и приключения обычных людей. С самого начала мы знакомимся с Путешественником, прибывшим из другого мира и разлученным со своим близнецом таинственным божеством, что становится отправной точкой долгого и тернистого пути через семь огромных королевств. Тейват поражает своим визуальным исполнением и проработкой деталей, предлагая игрокам исследовать бескрайние просторы, от зеленых лугов свободолюбивого Мондштадта и величественных скал торговой гавани Ли Юэ до окутанных вечными грозами островов Инадзумы, пышных тропических джунглей Сумеру и высокотехнологичного оперного Фонтейна. Каждая локация обладает своей уникальной культурой, архитектурой, историей и великолепным музыкальным сопровождением, которое исполняется ведущими мировыми оркестрами, создавая неповторимую атмосферу погружения в живой мир. Одной из ключевых особенностей игрового процесса является инновационная система элементальных взаимодействий, основанная на использовании семи стихий: Анемо, Гео, Электро, Дендро, Гидро, Пиро и Крио. Игроки могут мгновенно переключаться между четырьмя персонажами в своем отряде в реальном времени, комбинируя их способности для создания мощных реакций, таких как Заморозка, Пар, Перегрузка или Бутонизация, что делает каждое сражение динамичным, зрелищным и тактически разнообразным. Система коллекционирования персонажей через механику молитв позволяет собрать уникальную команду из десятков героев, каждый из которых обладает не только собственной уникальной боевой ролью, но и детально прописанной предысторией, личными стремлениями и ярким дизайном в стиле аниме. Повествование в Genshin Impact не ограничивается только основной сюжетной линией о поиске родного человека; оно пронизывает многочисленные побочные квесты, описания артефактов и даже детали ландшафта, постепенно раскрывая глубокий и мрачный лор о павших цивилизациях, загадочной Бездне, коварных планах организации Фатуи и секретах божественного порядка Селестии. Игра постоянно развивается, каждые шесть недель предлагая игрокам масштабные обновления с новыми регионами, временными событиями, увлекательными мини-играми и сложными испытаниями, что поддерживает живой интерес сообщества на протяжении многих лет. Взаимодействие с миром дополняется возможностью кооперативного режима, где друзья могут объединяться для совместных битв с боссами или простого исследования территорий, хотя при этом проект остается глубоко личным приключением с возможностью медитативного прохождения. Это не просто видеоигра, а огромная, дышащая цифровая вселенная, сочетающая в себе высочайший уровень художественного исполнения, захватывающий геймплей и эпический размах повествования, который приглашает каждого стать частью великой легенды и найти ответы на фундаментальные вопросы о природе власти, свободы и самопожертвования, наслаждаясь при этом невероятными видами, открывающимися с вершин самых высоких гор Тейвата.

"Backroom Cleaners" is a four-player co-op roguelike shooter where you and your team are elite Axiom Corporation Cleaners deployed into the ever-shifting Backrooms—not to escape them, but to purge them. As specialized agents, your mission is to eliminate hostile entities, secure unstable zones, retrieve valuable samples, and push deeper into the endless maze of distorted rooms while containing the mysterious anomalies hidden within. (Steam Store) The game features class-based third-person combat, with each Cleaner bringing unique abilities that encourage teamwork and strategic coordination. Every expedition offers fresh build combinations through a roguelike progression system, allowing players to create powerful new loadouts while also unlocking permanent upgrades via a long-term skill tree. As you venture farther into the Backrooms, increasingly dangerous entities, procedurally generated encounters, and endlessly scaling difficulty ensure that no two runs play the same. (Steam Store) Developed by Hypercent Inc., "Backroom Cleaners" blends the eerie atmosphere of Backrooms horror with fast-paced cooperative action and roguelike progression. Instead of hiding from the horrors lurking in the liminal dimension, you become the hunters, turning one of the internet's most iconic horror settings into a combat-focused co-op experience. The game is currently targeting Q4 2026 in Early Access for PC, with console versions also planned. d: Reacting to another terrifying Pocong sighting… and this one feels way too real 😳 For anyone who doesn’t know, the Pocong (aka the “shrouded ghost”) is one of the scariest spirits in Indonesian & Malaysian folklore. Legend says it’s the soul of someone whose burial shroud was never released… trapped, wrapped, and restless. They’re said to hop, not walk — bound by the cloth — appearing pale, bruised, and silent. If you ever hear knocking at night or see one watching from a distance… run. 👻 This clip is going viral right now, and honestly, the movement in the background gave me chills. Real or staged? You decide. #fyp #creepy #scarytiktoks #scary #horrortok

I came across another terrifying video showing what locals believe to be a Pocong — one of the scariest ghosts in Indonesian and Malaysian folklore. The Pocong is said to be the restless spirit of someone whose burial shroud was never untied after death. In Islamic tradition, the body is wrapped tightly in white cloth, and if the ties at the head or feet aren’t released after 40 days, the soul can’t move on. That’s when the Pocong rises… hopping from grave to grave, its face pale and eyes sunken, searching for someone to help free it — or to take revenge. Some say it smells like rotting flowers before it appears. Others claim you’ll hear a faint hopping sound outside your window before it shows itself. Whether this clip is real or fake, there’s something unsettling about how it moves… Do you think this video caught a real Pocong or something else entirely? 👀 #fyp #scary #creepy #horrortok #scarytiktoks

Hal ini biasanya dikaitkan dengan lokasinya yang terpencil, jarang digunakan, gelap, atau berada di dekat sawah, hutan, sungai, atau kebun. Namun, anggapan tersebut berasal dari tradisi, mitos, dan pengalaman yang diceritakan turun-temurun, bukan dari bukti ilmiah yang dapat diverifikasi. Dari sudut pandang yang lebih rasional, gubuk yang sepi memang dapat menimbulkan kesan angker karena pencahayaan minim, suara angin, hewan nokturnal, atau bangunan yang sudah lapuk dapat memicu rasa takut dan membuat orang lebih mudah menafsirkan hal-hal yang tidak biasa sebagai sesuatu yang gaib. Jadi, apakah sebuah gubuk benar-benar menjadi tempat makhluk halus bergantung pada keyakinan masing-masing, karena hingga saat ini tidak ada bukti ilmiah yang memastikan keberadaan makhluk halus di tempat tertentu. . . d: Kuntilanak adalah sebutan untuk hantu perempuan yang sangat populer dalam di Indonesia, khususnya di daerah Jawa dan sebagian besar daerah di Indonesia. Dalam berbagai cerita, kuntilanak digambarkan sebagai roh wanita yang meninggal saat melahirkan atau dalam kondisi hamil, dan seringkali digambarkan sebagai sosok yang pendendam dan mengganggu manusia. Kuntilanak seringkali dikaitkan dengan berbagai mitos dan cerita horor, seperti sosok yang memiliki suara tertawa melengking yang menyeramkan, atau sosok yang sering muncul di area yang sunyi dan gelap. Selain itu, dalam beberapa cerita, kuntilanak juga digambarkan sebagai sosok yang bisa menampakkan wujud fisik, seperti sosok wanita dengan pakaian putih dan rambut panjang yang berantakan. Asal-usul kuntilanak sangat bervariasi, namun umumnya diyakini bahwa kuntilanak adalah roh wanita yang meninggal karena melahirkan atau keguguran dan tidak bisa tenang setelah kematiannya.Ada yang punya pengalaman mistis sama sosok satu ini👀 #Viralmedia #Trendsmedia #Horror #HorrrorVideos #Dagelanmistis #Mistismedia #Creepy #Ceritamistis #Ceritaseram

d: Sebuah video yang diunggah ke media sosial menjadi viral karena merekam teror suara tawa misterius yang mirip kuntilanak dan sangat meresahkan warga setempat. Unggahan tersebut menunjukkan keresahan yang dialami warga, terutama seorang wanita yang merekam kejadian tersebut, karena teror itu terjadi hampir setiap malam. ​Keresahan Dimulai Pukul 01:33 Dini Hari ​Dalam unggahan video yang singkat namun intens tersebut, terlihat seorang wanita merekam lingkungan yang gelap sambil mengungkapkan rasa geramnya. Teror suara tersebut dilaporkan sudah mulai terdengar sejak pukul 01:33 subuh dan membuat warga merasa resah. ​Wanita tersebut, yang merupakan pemilik akun, menuliskan bahwa teror yang dialaminya adalah tawa sosok misterius yang ia sebut sebagai "ketawa kuntilanak". ​"Virall. Seorang wanita geram setiap malam di teror oleh ketawa sosok lalu iya kesal merekam nya sampai warga mencarinya." ​Warga Turun Tangan ​Keresahan ini tidak hanya dialami oleh satu orang. Karena intensitas teror yang terjadi setiap malam, warga sekitar bahkan dilaporkan ikut turun tangan dan berusaha mencari sumber suara misterius tersebut.  Perekam video sempat menuliskan kalimat bernada tantangan dan kekesalan: "Asli wee ketawa kuntilanak" dan "di mana kau." ​Meskipun beberapa spekulasi awal mengaitkan suara tersebut dengan binatang, namun di dalam unggahan tersebut disebutkan bahwa suara itu bukan berasal dari "musang bulan". Hal ini semakin memperkuat misteri di balik suara tawa yang muncul di dini hari.

d: In 2000, Mike Marcum became one of the internet’s strangest unsolved mysteries. According to his own claims, he believed he had built a device capable of manipulating time inside his backyard using salvaged electronics and powerful electromagnetic coils. He later appeared on the radio show Coast to Coast AM, describing bizarre experiments that allegedly produced unexplained effects. Then… he disappeared. Years later he briefly resurfaced, claiming he had experienced events he couldn’t explain, before largely fading from public view again. Whether his story was an elaborate hoax, a misunderstood experiment, or something else entirely remains a mystery that still fascinates people online decades later. Sometimes the strangest stories are the ones no one can completely explain. #timetravel #timemachine #unsolvedmysteries #analoghorror #mystery
zh: 2000年，Mike Marcum成为互联网上最离奇的未解谜案之一。据他本人声称，他相信自己用废旧电子元件和强力电磁线圈在自家后院建造了一台能够操控时间的装置。他后来出现在电台节目Coast to Coast AM上，描述了一系列据称产生了无法解释效果的怪异实验。随后……他失踪了。多年后他短暂重新出现，声称经历了一些自己无法解释的事情，之后便再度淡出公众视野。他的故事究竟是精心策划的骗局、被误解的实验，还是别的什么，至今仍是一个谜，数十年后依然令网友着迷。有时候，最奇异的故事恰恰是那些没有人能完全解释的故事。

d: Thai horror understands something Western ghost stories rarely do: the dead don't leave because they have unfinished business, they leave because they choose to. These six films treat lingering spirits not as monsters but as consequences. 1. ชัตเตอร์ กดติดวิญญาณ (2004): The ghost shows up in photographs before she shows up in person, and that slow reveal makes the dread unbearable. A defining film for the entire regional genre. 2. แฝด (2007): When one twin dies and the other survives, the dead sister refuses to accept the arrangement. The film weaponizes the intimacy of shared flesh. 3. ร่างทรง (2021): Shot as a documentary, this film blurs possession and inheritance until you can't tell where belief ends and terror begins. Relentlessly uncomfortable. 4. นางนาก (1999): The legend of Mae Nak is Thailand's most beloved ghost story, and this version plays it straight, letting love carry the horror further than any monster could. 5. พี่มาก..พระโขนง (2013): A horror-comedy that somehow makes you root for the ghost. The same legend as Nang Nak, rerouted through grief and dark humor. 6. บ้านเช่า..บูชายัญ (2023): A cult horror that escalates from domestic unease to full supernatural siege, with a landlord who never signed up for any of this. #ThaiHorror #SoutheastAsianHorror #ForeignHorror #Shutter #TheMedium #NangNak #PeeMak #Horror #WorldCinema #GhostFilms #AsianHorror #HorrorFilms
h: thaihorror, southeastasianhorror, foreignhorror, shutter, themedium, nangnak, peemak, horror, worldcinema, ghostfilms, asianhorror, horrorfilms
zh: 泰国恐怖片理解了一件西方鬼故事鲜少触及的事：死者之所以不离去，不是因为有未竟之事，而是因为他们选择留下。这六部电影将徘徊的亡灵视为"因果"而非"怪物"。1.《鬼影》（2004）：鬼魂出现在照片里，先于现实中现身，这种缓慢揭示令人窒息，堪称整个东南亚恐怖类型片的奠基之作。2.《双生》（2007）：一对双胞胎，一死一生，死去的姐妹拒绝接受这种安排，影片将共同血肉的亲密感化作武器。3.《灵媒》（2021）：以纪录片形式拍摄，将附身与传承模糊至难以分辨信仰与恐惧的边界，令人持续

d: The Aswang is one of the most feared creatures in Filipino folklore. By day, it looks like an ordinary person, blending into villages unnoticed. But at night, it transforms into a terrifying predator that hunts humans, especially pregnant women and young children. Legends say the Aswang can separate its upper body from its lower half, sprout bat-like wings, and use a long, hollow tongue to feed on its victims from rooftops. For centuries, stories of the Aswang have been passed down across the Philippines, making it one of the world’s most infamous cryptids and supernatural beings. #folklore #filipino #aswang #fyp #viral
zh: 阿斯旺是菲律宾民间传说中最令人闻风丧胆的生物之一。白天，它看起来与普通人无异，悄无声息地混迹于村落之中。但到了夜晚，它便化身为可怕的猎食者，专门猎杀人类，尤其是孕妇和幼童。传说阿斯旺能将上半身与下半身分离，长出蝙蝠般的翅膀，并用细长中空的舌头从屋顶吸食猎物。几个世纪以来，关于阿斯旺的故事在菲律宾代代相传，使其成为世界上最臭名昭著的神秘生物

d: Lagu Multo dari Cup of Joe punya arti yang cukup mendalam. --- Makna Lagu Multo 1. “Multo” = “Hantu” Kata multo dalam bahasa Filipino berarti hantu.  Dalam lagu ini, “hantu” bukanlah hantu harfiah, tapi metafora untuk sesuatu/​seseorang dari masa lalu yang terus menghantui perasaan.  2. Kenangan yang Tak Terlupakan Lagu menggambarkan kesulitan untuk melupakan seseorang atau masa lalu, walaupun sudah berusaha move on. Kenangan muncul terus, seperti “hantu” yang tak kunjung hilang.  3. Perasaan Bersalah, Duka, dan Refleksi Diri Liriknya menyiratkan bahwa orang yang bercerita dalam lagu masih menghadap rasa sakit emosional, penyesalan, atau mungkin kehilangan yang belum bisa diterima sepenuhnya. Ada unsur refleksi, mencoba mengerti kenapa kenangan tersebut tetap ada.  4. Peralihan Emosional dan Musik Lagu ini juga dapat dilihat sebagai pergeseran musik untuk bandnya (Cup of Joe) — dari tema yang lebih ringan ke hal yang lebih introspektif dan emosional. Memakai “multo” sebagai simbol dari konflik batin dan perubahan dalam identitas emosional mereka.  --- Kalau kamu mau, aku bisa kasih terjemahan liriknya ke bahasa Indonesia juga supaya maknanya makin jelas — kamu mau? #multo #musik #anime #kaoru
zh: Cup of Joe的《Multo》有相当深刻的含义。--- 《Multo》歌曲解析 1."Multo"="鬼"，在菲律宾语中意为鬼魂，但歌中并非字面意义上的鬼，而是用来比喻过去某人或某事持续萦绕心头的感受。2. 难以忘却的回忆：歌曲描述了难以忘记某人或某段过去的困境，即使努力想要释怀，记忆依然如"鬼魂"般挥之不去。3. 愧疚、悲伤与自我反思：歌词暗示主人公仍在面对情感上的伤痛、遗憾，或许是一段尚未完全接受的失去，带有反思意味，试图理解为何那些记忆依然存在。4. 情感与音乐风格的转变：这首歌也可视为Cup of Joe乐队的音乐转型——从较为轻松的主题转向更具内省性和情感深度的风格，以"multo"象征内心冲突与情感认同的变化。--- 如果你想要，我也可以提供印尼语歌词翻译，让含义更加清晰，你有兴趣吗？

d: @chickennoodle266’s animation of Tung Tung Tung Sahur doing a @71cent dance to Cradles by Sub Urban is pure brainrot meme energy in the best way. It takes the instantly recognizable Tung Tung Tung Sahur character, adds a viral dance feel, and pairs it with the dark dreamy vibe of Cradles to create a chaotic edit that feels made to stop the scroll. What makes this work is the contrast. Tung Tung Tung Sahur already has that loud, weird, unforgettable meme presence, and putting that energy into a clean dance to Cradles makes the whole thing feel even more absurd and replayable. It has that perfect mix of creepy-cute, chaotic, and weirdly smooth energy that makes people watch again just because it should not go this hard. d: Did you catch this massive English subtitle fail in Duang with You?! 🛑🇹🇭 In this scene, the art professor catches the boys slacking off, and the subtitles translate his scolding as "Jeez. Assholes." But a real professor would be fired immediately for saying that in a classroom! The actual Thai word he mutters is "dek wane" (เด็กเวร). While it is definitely a reprimand, it translates much closer to a general term for "delinquents," "troublemakers," or "little rascals." Tone is so hard to capture in translation! 😂 What is the craziest BL translation fail you've ever seen? Let me know below! 👇 #DuangWithYou #TeeteePor #LearnThai #ThaiLanguage #ThaiDrama
zh: 你发现《与你同行》里这个超级离谱的英文字幕翻译错误了吗？剧中美术老师斥责摸鱼的男生，字幕竟译成"见鬼，混蛋"，真教授要是在课堂上这么说早被开除了！他说的泰语其实是"เด็กเวร"，意思更接近"不良少年""捣蛋鬼""小鬼头"。语气真的太难翻译了！你见过最离谱的BL字幕翻译错误是什么？评论告诉我！

d: You’ve Never Seen Dance Moves Like This The Dero dance is a high-energy routine known for its wild, unpredictable movements and nonstop flow. At first glance it looks chaotic, but a closer look reveals rhythm, timing, and impressive control. Dancers groove with their whole body, following the beat in a way that feels both messy and skillful. In some communities, this style has been practiced for decades, keeping the tradition alive through festivals, gatherings, and friendly competitions. It’s a unique combination of fun, endurance, and cultural identity that continues to stand out today.  #derodance #indonesia #tradition #interesting #interestingfacts #knowledge

d: Have you ever craved something you’ve never even had before? 😂 I randomly thought, what if I turned potatoes into boba? And let me tell you… they’re SO chewy and delicious!  Potato Boba Ingredients 3–4 russet potatoes 1 cup potato starch Salt, to taste For the chili oil topping 1 tsp gochugaru 1 tbsp chopped parsley or green onions 1 tbsp minced garlic 1 tbsp soy sauce 2–3 tbsp hot oil 1. Steam or boil the potatoes until fork tender (I steamed mine). 2. Mash them while they’re still hot. Add the potato starch and salt, then knead into a smooth dough. If it’s too dry, add a little water. 3. Roll the dough into small boba-sized balls. 4. Boil until they float to the surface, then transfer them to cold water. Drain well. 5. Place the potato boba in a bowl. Add the gochugaru, parsley or green onions, garlic, and soy sauce. 6. Pour the hot oil over everything and mix until well coated.

d: Nasi Goreng Indonesia - Indonesian Fried Rice #friedrice #easyrecipes #recipe  Ingredients 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 egg 3 cups cooked rice 4 slices fish cake, thinly sliced 4 large prawns, peeled and deveined A handful of fresh squid, cleaned and sliced 1 tbsp light soy sauce 2 tbsp kecap manis (sweet soy sauce) 1 tsp dark caramel sauce 1 tbsp sambal (adjust to taste) Large pinch of YumYum or MSG 1 bird’s eye chili, finely sliced 1 spring onion, thinly sliced 2 tbsp fried garlic Sliced cucumber and tomato, to serve Fried egg, to serve INSTRUCTIONS 1. Heat a wok over high heat and add a splash of oil. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant. 2. Crack in the egg and scramble it quickly, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks. 3. Add the cooked rice to the wok and toss thoroughly, breaking up any clumps and ensuring it’s well-coated in the egg and garlic mixture. 4. Add the fish cake, prawns, and squid. Toss everything together and stir-fry until the seafood is cooked through. 5. Mix in the light soy sauce, kecap manis, dark caramel sauce, and sambal. Stir well to evenly coat the rice and proteins with the sauce. 6. Toss in the bird’s eye chili and sliced spring onion. Stir-fry briefly to combine. 7. Sprinkle the fried garlic over the rice and give it one final toss. 8. Serve hot, garnished with sliced cucumber and tomato, and top with a fried egg.
zh: 印尼炒饭食谱——材料：大蒜3瓣（切末）、鸡蛋1个、熟米饭3杯、鱼饼4片（切薄片）、大虾4只（去壳去肠）、新鲜鱿鱼一把（切片）、生抽1汤匙、甜酱油2汤匙、黑焦糖酱1茶匙、参巴辣酱1汤匙、味精少许、鸟眼辣椒1根（切碎）、青葱1根（切薄片）、炸蒜2汤匙、黄瓜和番茄片（配菜）、煎蛋（配菜）。做法：1.热锅加油爆香蒜末；2.打入鸡蛋快速炒散；3.加入米饭翻炒均匀；4.加入鱼饼、虾和鱿鱼翻炒至熟；5.加入生抽、甜酱油、黑焦糖酱和参巴酱拌匀；6.加入辣椒和青葱翻炒；7.撒上炸蒜翻炒；8.配黄瓜、番茄和煎蛋趁热享用。

Mom’s Indonesian Beef Rendang 🇲🇨   What I grew up eating for over 17 years back in my hometown, Indonesia🇲🇨😍. Today, I share this recipe with you, in honor of Indonesia's Independence Day. Happy Independence Day Indonesia, Indonesia MERDEKA! 🇮🇩✨ Ingredients A: 1.4kg of beef, topside or silverside, diced into 4cm chunks 800ml of regular coconut cream 400ml of coconut milk 1 tbsp of chicken powder 1 tbsp of Sugar 2 tsp of salt 2 tbsp of coconut sugar 6 tbsp of vegetable oil for stir fry  Ingredients B, to blend: 15 cloves of garlic  3 medium onions or 250g, chopped 30g of ginger,, cut into small pieces  30g of turmeric, cut into small pieces 6 candlenuts 30g of galangal, cut into small pieces 4 stalks lemongrass, chopped 6 tbsp of vegetable oil, to blend Ingredients C: 5 bay leaves 8 kaffir lime leaves 4 lemongrass, chopped 8 cloves wholes 3 cinnamon sticks 4 cardamoms 4 star anises Seasoning: 2 tsp of cilantro ground 2 tsp of turmeric ground 2 tsp of white pepper 2 tsp of cinnamon powder Steps: 1. Cut the beef into 4cm chunks and do not cut the beef into smaller pieces as they will break down during the cooking. 2. Add all of the Ingredients B in a blender or food processor. Then, blend it or give it a blitz until all the become a thick paste. Set aside 3. In the heavily-bottomed pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat. 4. Then, pour the paste (from Ingredients B) into the pan and cook the paste until fragrant for 2 minutes. 5. Add the “Ingredients C” to the pan and stir to mix. 6. Next, add the “Seasoning” and followed by chicken powder, sugar and salt to the pan. Cook the paste until fragrant ( the paste will change color to red-brown ish ) 7. Add the beef to the pan and cook the beef until it is lightly browned.  8. Add coconut milk into the pan and stir to combine. Then, add coconut cream and bring it to simmer. 9. Cover and simmer in low heat for 1 hour until the beef is tender and the sauce thickens. (Stir it periodically to prevent the meat from burning) 10. Once the sauce has thickened and released reddish oil, add coconut sugar and give it a final mix. 11. Cover and simmer for another 30 minutes until it turns into dark brown. 12. Once it is done, enjoy with a bowl of rice! Notes: You should let the meat sit overnight for the flavors to be fully absorbed in the meat #indonesianfood #beefrendang #dinnerideas #easyrecipes

• Sate Ayam Madura • Dulu bikin sate madura sendiri kayaknya ribet banget. Padahal, bikin sate sendiri lebih puas lho. Selain bahan yang digunakan terjamin, ukuran dagingnya juga bisa disesuaikan sesuai selera kita. Bahan bumbu kacang: 100 gr kacang tanah 3 siung bawang merah 2 siung bawang putih 2 butir kemiri 300 ml air 1/2 sdt garam 1 1/2 sdm gula merah 3 sdm kecap manis 1/2 sdt kaldu jamur Bahan sate: 250 gr paha ayam fillet Bahan bumbu marinasi: 3 sdm bumbu kacang 1 sdm minyak goreng 2 sdm kecap manis Cara membuat: 1. Membuat bumbu kacang - Goreng kacang tanah, bawang merah, bawang putih, dan kemiri. Kemudian haluskan. Tambahkan air agar lebih mudah halus. - Panaskan minyak, masukkan bumbu kacang yang telah halus. - Tambahkan semua bahan lainnya, aduk-aduk. Masak sampai mengental. 2. Membuat sate Potong daging ayam sesuai selera. Tusuk dengan menggunakan tusukan sate. Setiap tusuk isi dengan 3-5 potongan daging ayam. 3. Membuat bumbu marinasi Campur semua bahan dan aduk sampai rata. 4. Campurkan sate ke dengan bumbu marinasi. Diamkan minimal 15 menit. 5. Panggang sate di atas teflon dengan api sedang, bolak-balik. Oles juga dengan sisa bumbu marinasi. ❌ copyrighted video by @dish.and.delight. d: Kalo punya harta 3T mending diginiin... berpotensi besar bakal nambah 2T!! 🤭😁🍴 Coba deh harta 3T sahabat, yaitu telur, tempe, dan tahu dimasak pake bumbu balado begini... bisa-bisa nambah 2T lagi.. tembem dan tambun maksudnya 😁🤭 Masaknya gampang, murah, pasti bisa dibikin di rumah.. bahkan buat anak kost juga bisa banget 😍😍😍 BALADO TELUR, TEMPE & TAHU Bahan 1: (blender) • 8 Buah Bawang Merah • 150 ml Air • 1 Sachet Desaku Balado Bahan 2: • 6 SDM Minyak Goreng • 1 Buah Tomat (diris) • 1/2 SDT Garam • 1 SDM Gula • 100 ml Air Bahan 3: • 4 Biji Telur Rebus • 150 Gr Tahu (potong sesuai selera) • 150 Gr Tempe (potong sesuai selera) Cara Memasak: 1. Goreng Tahu, Tempe dan Telur sampai berkulit. 2. Blender Bumbu (Bahan 1). 3. Panaskan 6 Sendok Makan minyak Goreng, Tumis bumbu yang sudah di-blender (Bahan 1) Sampai naik minyak. 4. Tambahkan Tomat, Gula dan Garam, aduk sampai tomat layu. 5. Masukkan Telur, Tempe dan Tahu yang sudah digoreng. Tambahkan 100 ml Air, masak sampai bumbu meresap. 6. Matikan api, angkat dan sajikan. #resepsimple #masakanrumahan #menuanakkos

d: Nasi lemak! My favourite Malaysian meal, always. Fragrant coconut rice cooked with pandan, crispy anchovies, peanuts, egg, cucumber and golden fried chicken. Honestly one of the best comfort meals - and perfect for iftar during ramadan. Save this if you want to try making nasi lemak at home and selamat ramadan to everyone observing <3 🌙  Serves 3   For the nasi (rice): 1 banana shallot  1/2 bulb of garlic cloves 1 lemongrass  230g jasmine rice 400ml coconut milk 1 tsp salt 1 pandan leaf For the rempah (spice paste): 8 chicken drumsticks 1 bulb of garlic  2 banana shallots 20g ginger 2 lemongrass stalks 1 tbsp salt 1/2 tsp MSG 1/2 tsp white pepper 1 tsp sugar 2 tbsp curry powder  2 tsp chilli powder  For the milk mix: 1 pint of milk 4 tbsp rice flour 8 tbsp self raising flour For the flour mix: 20g rice flour 40g self raising flour 120g potato starch 60g peanuts 60g dried anchovies 6 tbsp sambal @mamayuchillioil 3 eggs 1/2 cucumber 6 pieces of fried chicken (ayam goreng) 1L vegetable oil, for deep frying Using a sharp knife, make 2–3 shallow slits on each piece of chicken, focusing on the thicker parts to help the marinade penetrate and ensure even cooking. Add the chicken to a large bowl, pour in the milk and leave to soak for at least 30 minutes. This will help tenderise the meat. Meanwhile, for the rice, halve the shallot and lemongrass, smash the garlic and add them to a wok with 3 tbsp of vegetable oil. Stir-fry for 2 minutes on medium-low heat until fragrant, then set aside. Wash the rice three times until the water runs clear, then add it to a pot with coconut milk, salt and the fried shallot, garlic and lemongrass. Stir, then tie the pandan leaf into a knot and add it to the rice. Once boiling, turn the heat to low and cook for 12 minutes. For the spice paste, roughly chop the aromatics and blend the garlic, shallot, ginger and lemongrass in a food processor. Set aside for later. Stir-fry the peanuts with 1 tbsp of vegetable oil until crispy, then set aside. Fry the anchovies until crispy and set aside. Boil the eggs to your liking (I usually boil them for 10 minutes for nasi lemak) and slice the cucumber into ½ cm thick slices. Remove the chicken from the milk (save the milk for later), allowing any excess to drip off. Add the blended paste and remaining seasonings, mix well and set aside. Prepare the milk mixture and flour mixture in two separate bowls. Dredge the chicken in the milk mixture, then into the flour mixture, and repeat for the remaining drumsticks. In a large wok, heat the oil over medium heat until it reaches 175°C. You can test if the oil is ready by dropping in a small piece of flour mixture - it should sizzle and float to the top. You can also place chopsticks into the oil - if bubbles form around them, the oil is hot enough. Fry the chicken on medium-high heat for 6 minutes, flipping halfway through, then on medium-low heat for 2 minutes, flipping halfway through. Fry in batches to avoid overcrowding until the chicken is crispy, golden and cooked through. Remove the fried chicken and place it on a wire rack or paper towel to drain excess oil. Serve the nasi lemak (coconut rice) with fried chicken, anchovies, peanuts, cucumber slices, a boiled egg and sambal.

d: 부추짜박이 레시피 ​재료 ​주재료: 부추 400g, 양파 1개, 대파 약간, 홍고추 2~3개 ​양념: 양조간장 150ml, 멸치액젓 3스푼, 참치액 3스푼, 맛술 5스푼, 올리고당 5스푼, 간마늘 2스푼, 통깨 2~3스푼 ​추가: 참기름 (먹기 직전 첨가) ​조리 방법 ​부추 세척: 부추 밑단을 묶은 채 식초 반 컵을 넣은 물에 10분간 담근 뒤, 흔들어 씻고 물기를 털어낸다. ​재료 손질: ​부추를 1cm 간격으로 송송 썬다. ​양파를 곱게 다진다. ​대파는 포크로 찢은 뒤 잘게 썰고, 홍고추는 대충 다진다. ​양념장 만들기: 볼에 양조간장, 멸치액젓, 참치액, 맛술, 올리고당, 간마늘, 통깨를 넣고 섞는다. ​버무리기: 손질한 채소를 양념장에 넣고 살살 버무린다. (참기름은 먹을 때 추가) ​#부추짜박이 #밥도둑레시피 #초간단요리
zh: 韭菜腌酱食谱：韭菜400g、洋葱1个、大葱少许、红辣椒2-3个，调料为酿造酱油150ml、鳀鱼鱼露3勺、鲣鱼汁3勺、料酒5勺、低聚糖5勺、蒜末2勺、芝麻2-3勺，食用前加香油。韭菜用醋水浸泡10分钟后洗净，切成1cm段，洋葱切碎，大葱撕丝切末，红辣椒粗切，所有调料混合后与蔬菜轻轻拌匀即可

d: 🇵🇭🍗 Max’s Style Fried Chicken INGREDIENTS: *some measurements may be estimates only so season and adjust to your liking 🙏🫶 Chicken Marinade: - 6pcs chicken leg quarter - 1/4 cup patis - 1/4 cup ml of calamansi - 10 cloves of garlic, minced Chicken blanching liquid: - 3 onions, chopped - 3 heads garlic, halved - 1 stalk of cilantro/wansoy - ¼ cup of calamansi juice - 3-4 bay leaves  - ¼ cup of peppercorn - ¼ cup of patis - 1-2 sachets of Maggi Magic Sarap - marinating liquid - Water as needed Chicken Drying: - 1 sachet of Maggi Magic Sarap - 1 tsp of baking powder Chicken Frying: - Oil as needed Sweet Potato Fries: - 6 sweet potatoes, fries cut - Water as needed - ⅓ cup of white vinegar - 1/4 cup of flour - ¼ cup of cornstarch - ¼ cup of rice flour - 1 tsp of baking powder - 1 tsp of baking soda - Water from soaking - Oil Dipping: - Banana Ketchup - Worcestershire sauce INSTRUCTIONS - Marinate the chicken w/ all ingredients under “marinade”. Set aside for 2hrs-overnight. - Transfer the chicken to a pot and add all the ingredients under “Chicken Boiling Liquid.” Pour in enough water to cover most of the chicken, low simmer for around 15 mins. - Combine the Maggi Magic Sarap and baking powder, then season the chicken evenly. dry in fridge overnight uncovered. - Soak sweet potatoes in water and vinegar. Reserve some soaking water before draining. Combine the potatoes, flour, cornstarch, rice flour, baking powder, and baking soda. add a little reserved soaking liquid to create a light batter. deep fry at 165°C for 4-5mins or until crisp. - For the dipping sauce, combine the banana ketchup and Worcestershire sauce. - Serve fried chicken with rice, sweet potato fries, and dipping sauce. Enjoy! #CookwithMagic #cookingasmr #asmr

d: Where taxi drivers eat in Korea Jeyuk Bokkeum (Spicy Stir-Fried Pork) 🧡 Ingredients 500g thinly sliced pork shoulder 2 green onions 1/2 onion -for the sauce 1/2 tbsp gochujang 2 tbsp soy sauce 2 tbsp cooking wine (or mirin) 2 tbsp gochugaru 1 tbsp corn syrup 1 tbsp minced garlic 1/2 tbsp oyster sauce 1/2 tbsp sugar -for serving Cooked rice Lettuce and perilla leaves Sesame oil Sesame seeds 💙 Directions  1. In a small bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients. 2. Slice the onion and green onions. 3. Heat a lightly oiled pan over medium-high heat. Add the pork and cook until it's no longer pink. 4. Add the onion and green onions, then stir-fry until the onion has softened. 5. Pour in the sauce and cook for another 5 minutes, stirring frequently. 6. Finish with a drizzle of sesame oil and a sprinkle of sesame seeds. 7. Serve with rice, and wrap each bite in lettuce or perilla leaves. 🔖 Save this recipe for your next meal  🥰 Like, follow & comment if you enjoyed  .  .  . .  . . #koreanfood #easyrecipes #comfortfood #quickrecipe #jeyukbokkeum

d: レシピ👇 　　　仕込み10分！ あとはオーブンおまかせ🍳 　＼海外でバズってる！／ 🥩パリパリミートロール 今海外で話題のレシピを お家でも簡単に作れる様に アレンジしてみたよ〜😊 多めに作って、冷凍ストックもできる！ 冷凍したら、出してオーブンで焼くだけ☺️ 毎日頑張ってるママに オーブン料理の“手軽さ”を届けたい🍳 予熱の間に仕込めて オーブンに入れたら、 あとは火加減不要だから 焦げや煮詰めすぎの心配無し🙂‍↕️ 待ってる間は洗い物したり お洗濯したり、 ちょっとひと息タイムしたり☕️🫶 ✔ 洗い物ほぼ無し ✔ 食べムラっ子爆食い👧🏻👦🏻 ✔️油はねヤケドの心配なし ——— ⚫︎パリパリミートロール 【材料】予熱210度に熱しておく ○豚ミンチ　　　　　500g  (お好みで合挽きでもOK) ○キャベツ　　　　　1/4個 ○玉ねぎ　　　　　中1/2個 ○ジャガイモ　　　2〜3個 ★牛乳　　　　　　　大1.5 ★塩　　　　　　　　小1.5 ★胡椒　　　　　　　少々 ★マヨネーズ　　　　大1  ★ニンニク　　　　　1カケ ★粉チーズ　　　　　大1.5 (チューブの場合　2〜3cm) 　お好みで飾りパセリ🌿 ◎はるまきの皮　　１袋(10枚) ◎油(皮に塗る用)       少量 ◎油(かける用)　　　適量 　 《タレ》 ●オーロラソースがオススメ！ ケチャップ2:マヨネーズ1   ⇨混ぜる🙌 他には、おろしポン酢も美味しいよ😋 【作り方】 ①キャベツ、玉ねぎをスライスする (お好みで細みじん切りでもOK) ②お肉と★を入れよく混ぜ 　5等分にする ③ジャガイモを1.5〜2cm厚に切る 　はるまきの皮を2枚ごとにはがす ④ 天板にクッキングシートを敷き    皮に"②"のお肉を広げる。 　皮後半2割くらい残し、 　その部分に油を指で少量塗る ✅お肉は横はみ出るくらいに広げる 　(スカスカにならない様に) 　切った後に形を整えます🙌 ⑤ミートロールを丸める 　なるべく空気が入らない様に 　少し力を加えながら 　巻き終わりの部分は下にして 　皮同士がくっつく様にする ⑥ミートロールを切る 　(5等分がおすすめ) ⑦油を全体にうすくかける ⑧210度のオーブン下段25分焼く 　⇨完成🙌 火加減いらずのほったらかし🍳 「これなら作れそう！」と思ったら 忘れないように保存してね📌 #海外バズレシピ #オーブン #シンママ #はるまきの皮

d: 🇵🇭 Pork Adobo | Filipino Food Bible – Episode 1 My take on one of the most iconic Filipino dishes - Pork Adobo! This series will feature all filipino dishes in all their variations. consider this your guide to filipino cuisine. comment what you wanna see next! INGREDIENTS: Pork Adobo - 1.2 kg pork belly (or cut of choice) - 15–20 cloves garlic, minced (adjust to taste—more is always welcome) - 1 onion, chopped - 500 ml pork broth - 190 ml soy sauce - 100 ml cane vinegar - 3 long green chilies - 4 bay leaves - 1 tbsp whole peppercorns - 30 g palm sugar, chopped (adjust to sweetness) - Oil, for frying Toppings - Sliced onion leeks - Crispy garlic bits - Boiled eggs INSTRUCTIONS - Fry the pork until lightly browned on all sides, then remove and set aside. - In the same pot, sauté the garlic until lightly golden and fragrant. Add onions and cook until softened. - Return the pork to the pot, pour in the pork broth. Add the soy sauce, vinegar, green chilies, bay leaves, peppercorns, and palm sugar.  - Cover and let simmer on medium heat for 5-10 mins **don’t mix to allow vinegar to cook.  - Turn to low heat for 1–2 hours, until the pork is tender and the sauce has reduced. you want it to be almost swimming in its own fat like a confit - Optional: If serving with eggs, add the soft boiled eggs 2-3 mins before serving to retain jammyness - Serve over hot rice, topped with crispy garlic and leeks, and a hard-boiled egg on the side. Enjoy. #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr #pinoyfood

🇵🇭 Kare Kare | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 10 Kare-kare is a rich Filipino stew made with oxtail, tripe, and vegetables, all simmered in a thick peanut sauce. It’s usually served with bagoong (fermented shrimp paste) on the side to balance the flavors and an extra level of umami and saltiness 😋 INGREDIENTS: Boiling liquid: - 1-2 red onions, chopped - 2 bulbs of garlic, chopped - 1 tbsp of salt - 1 tbsp peppercorns - 5-6 bay leaves - 1 kg of oxtail - 650g of ox tripe - Beef stock as needed Kare Kare: - 10g of annatto powder - 2 tablespoons oil - 15-20 cloves garlic, minced - 2 tbsp annatto powder - 1 white onion, diced - 1 banana heart, chopped, washed and rinsed w/ salt - Beef stock as needed - green beans, chopped - eggplants, quartered - pechay/bok choy - 1 ½ cup peanut butter - Patis to taste - ½ teaspoon salt - 1 tbsp of sugar (optional to taste) Toasted rice slurry: - 1:5 tbsp of water to toasted rice, blended Served with:  - Bagoong  - Crushed peanuts INSTRUCTIONS:  - Start by seasoning your meat with salt and pepper and sear. Add all ingredients under “boiling liquid” and fill the pot as needed with beef stock. Simmer until tender, remove meat and set aside the broth for later.  - Saute onions, garlic, and banana hearts in oil mixed with annatto powder. Add your meat back and cover with the broth from the boiling liquid and simmer for 15-20 minutes. - To thicken the mixture, add toasted rice to a food processor or blender. Take some of the rice and mix with water to form our slurry.  - Add both rice slurry and peanut butter stir and reduce to thicken. Season with patis/salt/pepper and add your vegetables.  - Serve alongside bagoong top and enjoy!  #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #PinoyFood

d: 🇵🇭 Chicken Tinola (Tinolang Manok) | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 9  Tinola a humble yet comforting chicken soup dish dates back to the pre-colonial Philippines. For my version I also used Native chicken for its added flavor along with cubes of chicken blood which is used by some households when preparing this dish INGREDIENTS: Chicken Tinola - 1 onion, sliced - 10-15 cloves of garlic, sliced - 80-100g of ginger, sliced - 1 native chicken, portioned (you can also use regular whole chicken) - 1 stalk of lemongrass - 400-500g of green papaya, cut into wedges - 6-8 pcs of green chilies - 3-5 tbsp of patis - 1-2 cups of chili leaves - 2 cups of moringa/malunggay leaves  - Chicken stock as needed - Salt and pepper to taste Chicken blood: - 1 block of chicken blood - A pinch of salt - Pepper to taste - Oil INSTRUCTIONS - Start by sauteing onions, garlic and ginger in a pot until softened. Add your sliced chicken. - Add in your lemongrass stalk, patis, and salt and pepper and cover and allow to simmer for 40mins - 1hr 30mins (depending on what chicken you use) until soft. -  add in the rest of your vegetables and simmer for 15 mins. Add in the leaves at the very last min and allow residual heat to cook them. set aside. - Add your block of chicken blood along with some salt, and boil for 10-15 minutes. Remove and slice into cubes. - Shallow fry cubes for 3-5 mins - Serve the tinola w your chicken blood and enjoy! #cookingasmr #asmr #filipinofood #pinoyfood

🇵🇭 Ngohiong | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 13 Cebuano ngohiong coming from Filipino Chinese influence -  is essentially a battered deep fried spring roll, filled with seasoned meat, vegetables, and the distinct aroma of five-spice.  But  what even makes it better is  its thick, sweet, savory, and spicy dipping sauce. *most measurements are estimates. Season and adjust to your liking :) INGREDIENTS: Wrapping: - Lumpia wrappers as needed Filling: - ½ kilogram of ground pork - 5 cups heart of palm/ubod, julienned - 1 white onion, sliced - 15-20 cloves of garlic, minced - Green Onion/Leeks - 1 tsp 5 spice powder - ¼ cup soy sauce - ¼ cup sugar - 2 tbsp of oyster sauce - 1 tsp of white pepper - 1 stalk of spring onions, sliced Dipping batter: - 1 1/2 cup flour - 1/2 cup cornstarch - 2 cups water - 1 tsp five spice powder - 1/2 tsp salt - 1/2 tsp black pepper - annatto for color  - 2 tbsp oil Ngohiong sauce: - 250g of potato - red chili to taste (labuyo) - 1 carrot, chopped - 15-20 cloves of garlic, sliced - 1 cup of vinegar - 1 tbsp of fish sauce - 1 cup of sugar - Annatto for color - 2 cups of Water INSTRUCTIONS:  - Saute garlic and onions in a pan. Add all the ingredients under “Filling,” then cook until the pork is fully cooked and everything is well combined. - Place filling near the bottom of each lumpia wrapper. Brush the top edge with a flour-and-water mixture, then roll tightly and seal. Set aside. - To make the dipping batter, combine all the ingredients under “Dipping Batter”. Dip each into the batter, then fry at 165°C for 4–5 minutes, or until golden and crisp. - For the ngohiong sauce, add all the ingredients under “Ngohiong Sauce” to a pot. boil until the carrots and potatoes are soft, then blend until smooth. - Serve the ngohiong hot and crispy with a generous amount of sauce, and enjoy! #cookingasmr #asmr #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood

d: 🇵🇭 Pork Binagoongan | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 11 One of the more underrated but S tier Filipino dishes!! Usually made with pork simmered in “bagoong alamang”, or fermented shrimp paste - best served with rice, sometimes with eggplant or green mango on the side. Its savory, funky, and slightly sweet, with tons of umami 💡Pro tip: adjust depending on your bagoong. Not all bagoong tastes the same — some are saltier, milder, or sweeter — so taste as you go and balance it out with sugar, vinegar, and tomatoes. INGREDIENTS: Binagoongan: - 1.5 kg pork ribs, blanched (you can use pork belly or cut of choice) - 5-6 tbsp bagoong guisado - 1 large onion, diced - 15-20 cloves garlic, sliced - 4 long green chilies, sliced - 350g tomatoes, sliced - 1/3 cup cane vinegar - 1/3 cup brown sugar - 1/4 cup soy sauce - Water as needed - Black pepper, to taste Bagoong Guisado: - 400g shrimp paste (alamang) - 25-30 cloves garlic - 7-10 red chilies - 6-7 shallots - 400g tomatoes, diced - 1/4 cup vinegar - 1/3 cup brown sugar Ensaladang Mangga: - Green mango - Red onion - Cilantro - Tomato - Lime - Salt - Pepper INSTRUCTIONS:  - Blanch pork for 10 minutes, before straining and rinsing. Set aside. - To make the bagoong start by blitzing onions or shallots, garlic, and red chilies in a processor.  Add to cold pan with oil and cook until garlic is slightly oasted add tomatoes, alamang, sugar and vinegar. Allow this to simmer until the oil comes out and the tomatoes are jammy. - For the binagoongan start by sauteing onions, garlic, and chilies. add back your meat and all other ingredients listed under  “Binagoongan” and simmer for 40mins-1hr or until tender - In the meantime you can pair this with a fresh ensalada by combining all ingredients under “ensalada”. - Serve and enjoy! #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #pinoyfood

d: 🇵🇭 Arroz a la Cubana | Filipino Food Bible Episode 5 Arroz a la Cubana originated in Spain, making its way to the Philippines during the colonial period. Though it is a popular humble dish in its country of origins, there are elements that are distinctly Filipino in our version that set it apart. Namely, the use of saba, ground meat and other seasonings! 😍 INGREDIENTS: Arroz a la Cubana: - 1 whole white onion, diced - 10-15 cloves of garlic, sliced - 1 large tomato, diced - 2-3 tsp of tomato paste - 2kg of ground beef - 1/3 cup of soy sauce - 2 tbsp of Worcestershire sauce - 1 large potato, diced - 1 large carrot, diced - 1-2 bell peppers, diced - 1/2 cup of green peas - 1/2 cup of raisins - 1 tbsp of Spanish paprika - Salt and pepper to taste Others: - saba banana, sliced in half and fried - 2 eggs, sunny side up INSTRUCTIONS:  - To start sauté onions, garlic, and tomatoes until soft before adding tomato paste and mixing them together.  - Then add your ground meat, adding Worcestershire and soy sauce. Add vegetables like carrots, potatoes, bell peppers, and green peas along with raisins for added sweetness.  - Mix together, and season with paprika, salt, and pepper.  - Serve with saba, a heaping serving of your arroz a la Cubana, fried eggs and enjoy! #cookingasmr #asmr #filipinofood #pinoyfood

🇵🇭 Beef Salpicao | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 12 My take on a delicious FIlipino-Spanish dish usually made with tender beef cubes cooked in garlic, butter and Worcestershire sauce — but with extra garlic flavor!  * this recipe is only a guideline. most ingredients are just estimates so taste and adjust with your ❤️ INGREDIENTS: Beef salpicao: - 500g ribeye steak (or any cut of steak of your choice) - 300g of button mushrooms - Salt and pepper to taste - Oil for frying - 1/4 block of butter - 15-20 cloves of garlic, minced - 3 tbsp of Worcestershire sauce  - 1  tbsp of oyster sauce  - 2 tbsp of paprika  Garlic confit: - 300g of peeled garlic cloves - Olive Oil to cover Garnish: - parsley - crunchy garlic - pickled peppers INSTRUCTIONS: - Start by seasoning your steak and grilling until medium rare. Slice them into bite sized chunks and set aside for later - Slice button mushrooms. In a pan , add oil and/or butter, sauté the button mushrooms until they get deeper in color. Season with salt and pepper.  - Add minced garlic to a hot pan with oil and butter, and saute unti fragrant. Add back your steak and mushroom and add Worcestershire sauce, oyster sauce, paprika and black pepper. - To make it extra garlicky, we’re adding some garlic confit. To make it, simply add peeled garlic to a pot, cover with oil, and cook low and slow until the cloves are soft and golden. - Serve with garlic rice and enjoy! #CookingASMR #ASMR # FilipinoFood #pinoyfood

d: One of the biggest misconceptions about Filipino food is that it's all unhealthy. It's all brown, fried, fatty and salty. You know, the party foods? But it's far from the truth. There are plenty of "Lutong-bahay" or homestyle Filipino dishes that are nutrient-dense like "LASWA". It's an Ilongo vegetable soup dish that consists of a variety of exotic vegetables like eggplant, long beans or sitaw, kobucha squash or kalabasa, sponge gourd or patola, spinach, etc. Shrimp for protein is added and just salt for seasoning. Simple yet comforting and grabe, ang sarap! #filipino #filipinofood #filipinorecipe #foodtok #vegetables
zh: 关于菲律宾食物最大的误解之一是它全都不健康——颜色深、油炸、多脂、重口。那些派对食物确实如此，但这远非全貌。有很多"家常菜"营养丰富，比如"LASWA"——一道伊隆戈风味蔬菜汤，含茄子、长豆角、南瓜、丝瓜、菠菜等多种蔬菜，加虾补充蛋白质，仅用盐调味，简单却治愈，真的很好吃！

d: This might be the only soup I will never get tired of eating 🥰 Beef Sinigang is so comforting and delicious!  Ingredients 2 packets @knorr tamarind soup mix 1 lb beef brisket 3 beef spare ribs Fish sauce to taste 3 tomatoes 1 large onion 2 taro root Handful of okra 1 eggplant 6 bundles bok choy Handful of green beans 3 Thai chili Salt & pepper to taste Instructions Season the brisket with salt, pepper, and fish sauce. Sear with 1 tomato, 1/2 onion, and taro until browned. Cover with water and pressure cook for 45 minutes. Add remaining veggies + tamarind soup mix. Boil until veggies are tender (not mushy). Serve with rice and enjoy. #sinigang #beefsinigang #soursoup #filipinofood #pinoyfood
zh: 这可能是我唯一永远不会厌倦的汤——牛肉酸角汤既暖心又美味！食材：罗砖酸角汤料2包、牛胸肉500g、牛排骨3根、鱼露适量、番茄3个、大洋葱1个、芋头2个、秋葵一把、茄子1根、小白菜6棵、四季豆一把、泰国辣椒3根、盐和胡椒适量。做法：牛胸肉用盐、胡椒和鱼露腌制，与1个番茄、半个洋葱和芋头一起煎至上色，加水压力锅煮45分钟，加入剩余蔬菜和酸角汤料，煮至蔬菜软而不烂，配米饭享用。

Filipino Chicken BBQ (Inihaw na manok) Serves: 4–6 Prep Time: 15 minutes Marinate: Overnight Cook Time: 15–20 minutes Ingredients For the chicken & Skewers 	•	2-3 lbs Chicken Thighs deboned and cut in 4ths 	•	Wooden skewers, soaked in water for at least 2 hours BBQ Marinade 	•	1 cup ketchup (banana or tomato) 	•	½ cup soy sauce 	•	¼ cup calamansi juice (or lemon/lime juice) 	•	½ cup Sprite or 7Up 	•	8 cloves garlic, minced 	•	1 tsp garlic powder 	•	1 tbsp freshly ground black pepper 	•	1 tsp kosher salt BBQ Glaze 	•	1 cup ketchup 	•	1 tbsp soy sauce 	•	30g (about 2 tbsp) brown sugar 	•	3 cloves garlic, minced 	•	1 tsp black pepper 	•	1 tsp kosher salt Instructions 	1.	Marinate the Chicken In a large bowl or ziplock bag, combine all marinade ingredients. Add the chicken and mix well to coat. Cover and marinate in the fridge overnight. 	2.	Prepare the Skewers Soak wooden skewers in water for at least 2 hours to prevent burning. Thread the marinated chicken pieces tightly onto the skewers. Try your best to cover the chicken with the skin. This helps protect the chicken meat from overcooking. Packing them closely helps keep the meat juicy during grilling.  	3.	Make the Glaze In a bowl, mix together all glaze ingredients until well combined. No need to cook—this glaze will caramelize directly on the grill. 	4.	Grill the BBQ Preheat your grill to medium heat. Grill the chicken skewers for 12–15 minutes, turning every 4–5 minutes for even cooking. 	5.	Glaze and Finish Raise the heat to medium-high. Brush the skewers with the glaze and grill for another 1–2 minutes per side, letting the glaze slightly caramelize. Apply a second coat for extra flavor and color. 	6.	Serve Serve hot with steamed white rice or garlic fried rice. Pairs well with Filipino spiced vinegar (sawsawan)—check my page for the recipe! #filipinobbq #barbecue #recipe #food

Ube Custard Bread  Dough - 500g bread flour made from U.S. wheat - 60g sugar - 8g instant yeast - 8g salt - 1 egg - 260g milk - 40g butter Ube Custard Filling - 250g milk - 2 egg yolks - 50g sugar - 20g cornstarch - 100g ube halaya - 20g butter Procedure 1. Whisk milk, egg yolks, sugar, and cornstarch until smooth. 2. Cook over medium heat until thick. 3. Mix in ube halaya and butter until smooth. 4. Cool completely before using. 5. Prepare the dough and ferment. 6. Divide into 60g pieces. 7. Fill with 20g ube custard. 8. Shape into buns. 9. Proof until doubled. 10. Bake at 180°C for 15-18 minutes. d: I saw someone under this sound doing this with their culture so i wanted to do mine, I love our myths even though they’re mainly abt scaring kids to sleep or adults into islam😭 Here are a little introduction: Umm Al-Sa‘af Wal-Leef An eerie figure from Arabian folklore, wrapped in dried palm fronds, gliding silently through village paths at night. She haunts the dark to snatch disobedient children, her rustling body the warning before she strikes. Al-Dajjal Al-A‘war From Islamic eschatology comes the one-eyed deceiver, a false messiah who bends reality with lies. His voice seduces, his presence corrupts — and when he walks, even faith begins to tremble. The Jinn Ancient beings born of smokeless fire, woven into both Qur’anic scripture and folklore. They drift unseen between our world and theirs, watching, whispering , sometimes striking when least expected. Abu Fanous A shadowy wanderer carrying a glowing lantern, known across Gulf tales as a spirit who lures travelers astray. His light is soft, his path winding — follow it, and you may never find your way back. Himarat Al-Qayla The “Noon Donkey-Woman” of Arab oral myth appears during the quiet midday rest. She has a woman’s face, a donkey’s legs, and a hunger for children who defy the siesta hour. Ya’juj and Ma’juj (Gog and Magog) Mentioned in the Qur’an and Hadith, they are chaotic forces trapped behind a divine barrier. One day they will break free, flooding the world with destruction, leaving ruin in their wake. Al-Nasnas A grotesque creature from medieval Arab lore, said to be half a human, one eye, one arm, one leg. It leaps faster than thought, its breath diseased; a half-form born of something wholly wrong. Al-Rajul Al-Ma’i (The Water Man) A spectral being whispered of in Gulf and North African folklore, said to rise from wells and seas. He takes the shape of a man, soaked and silent. Those who see him by moonlight are never seen again. #arabianmythology #mythology #اساطير #خرافات #fyp
zh: 我看到有人用这个音乐介绍自己的文化，所以我也想介绍我的。我很喜欢我们的神话，尽管大多是用来吓孩子入睡或劝人信伊斯兰教的。简要介绍如下：乌姆·萨阿夫——阿拉伯民间传说中的诡异身影，裹着干棕榈叶，夜间悄无声息地滑过村道，专门抓不听话的孩子；独眼骗主达贾勒——伊斯兰末世论中的独眼伪救世主，能以谎言扭曲现实，令信仰动摇；精灵金恩——由无烟之火所生的古老存在，出入于人类与灵界之间，无形游荡，低语伺机；阿布·法努斯——提灯的神秘游荡者，海湾传说中诱使旅人迷路的灵体，跟随其光便再难寻归路；正午驴女——阿拉伯口传神话中在午休时分现身的女人面驴腿怪物，专捉不午睡的孩子；雅朱者与马朱者（歌革与玛各）——古兰经与圣训中被神圣屏障封印的混沌力量，末日将冲破束缚，带来毁灭；纳斯纳斯——中世纪阿拉伯传说中的半人怪物，独眼独臂独腿，跳跃迅捷，呼吸有毒；水人——海湾与北非民间传说中从水井或大海中升起的幽灵，化作浸透水的沉默男人形象，月光下见过他的人从此消失。

d: If you need an easy dinner recipe using a pound of ground beef, this Sloppy Joe Potato Skillet won’t disappoint!  INGREDIENTS  5 small/medium potatoes olive oil + salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika (for potatoes) 1 lb ground beef  1 chopped onion  1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper  1 tsp onion powder and paprika  1 tbsp minced garlic  1-2 tbsp Worcestershire  8 oz can tomato sauce  1/4 cup ketchup  1 tbsp mustard  2 tbsp bbq sauce  1 1/2 cups shredded Colby Jack cheese  Dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS  Peel, wash, and cut potatoes up into cubes.  Toss them with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  Cook the potatoes in the air fryer at 400 degrees F for about 20-25 minutes shaking them around at least a couple of times while they cook.  Once the potatoes are cooking, brown the ground beef and onion in a skillet and add all seasonings.  Add minced garlic, Worcestershire, tomato sauce, ketchup, mustard, and bbq sauce. Let simmer on low until the potatoes are ready.  Add crispy potatoes to the skillet with the sloppy joe mix and give it a quick stir. Sprinkle shredded cheese on top and put in the oven under broil just to melt the cheese.  Enjoy! #easyrecipes #dinner #sloppyjoes

d: KFC at Home Pt 1/3: The SECRET Fried Chicken Recipe… But Better 🍗 I choke slammed Colonel Sanders and stole his secret 11 herbs & spices recipe, then turned it into to one of the best fast food at home meals I’ve ever made 🤤  KFC Buffalo Ranch Recipe (upgraded) dropping soon if the Colonel doesn’t catch me first 🏃 👉 Full detailed recipes in bio 🔗 — CONDENSED RECIPE: KFC “Secret” 11 Herbs & Spices Mix together kosher salt, garlic powder, smoked paprika, black pepper, white pepper, thyme, oregano, mustard powder, ginger, basil, celery seed, and a little MSG (optional, but highly recommended). Reserve ⅓ for the marinade and ⅔ for the dredge. Chicken + Marinade Whisk together buttermilk, eggs, pickle juice, and ⅓ of the seasoning blend. Add chicken thighs + drumsticks, fully submerge, cover, and refrigerate overnight (or at least 4 hours). Double Dredge Combine flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and the remaining seasoning blend. Mix in a few spoonfuls of the marinade to create craggly bits. Remove the chicken from the marinade → dredge in the flour → back into the marinade → back into the flour (pressing and squeezing to fully coat) Fry Heat oil to 350°F. Fry until deeply golden brown and cooked to 165°F internal (thighs: 6–8 mins, drumsticks: 10–12 mins). Drain on a wire rack and hit with a little extra salt while they’re still hot. Serve Serve as-is or dip in my upgraded KFC Buffalo Ranch recipe DROPPING SOON 🔥 — #friedchicken #KFC #KFCcopycat #foodreels #chickenrecipe

Hot honey chicken sliders 🍔✨🍯 Ingredients  Chicken  - 1lb chicken breast, cut in half to create smaller pieces  - 1 1/3 cups buttermilk  - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1/4 cup pickle juice  - 1 1/2 cup all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp onion powder  - 2 tsp cayenne powder (use less if desired) - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp mustard powder  - 1 tsp salt - 1/2 tsp black pepper  - 1/2 tsp msg (optional) - Oil for frying  - Slider buns Hot honey sauce - 2 tbsp unsalted butter  - 1/3 cup hot sauce  - 1/2 cup honey - 1/2 tsp brown sugar  - 1/8 tsp salt  Instructions: - In a bowl, combine chicken pieces, buttermilk, seasonings, pickle juice and hot sauce. Let sit for 3 hours (or overnight in the fridge for best results). - In another bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, mustard powder, cayenne, salt, and pepper. - Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). - Remove chicken from marinade, letting excess drip off. Dredge in seasoned flour mixture, pressing to coat well. Rest the floured chicken for 10 minutes before frying  - Fry in batches 4–6 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Drain on a wire rack or paper towels.  - In a small saucepan combine honey, butter, and hot sauce. Mix until well combined. Let it simmer for 3-4 minutes then remove from heat - Brush chicken with hot honey sauce on both sides - Slice buns horizontally and brush with butter, place into a pan on medium high heat and toast until slightly golden brown.  - Mix melted butter, parsley and garlic powder. Brush over buns. • • • #hothoneychicken #friedchicken #DinnerIdeas #Recipe #hothoney #cooking

d: Cowboy butter steak bites ✨ My husband ate both of these plates and rated it a 10/10 😭 Ingredients  Steak - 2 pounds ribeye or sirloin steak, cubed - 1 tbsp neutral oil - 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - Salt and pepper to taste (generous amount) “Caramelized” onions  - 1 large yellow onion, sliced - 1 tsp granulated sugar  - Heaping pinch of salt Cowboy butter - 12 tbsp unsalted butter - 5 garlic cloves, minced  - 1 shallot, minced  - 1 lemon, freshly squeezed - 1 tbsp Dijon mustard  - 1 heaping tbsp parsley, chopped - 1 heaping tbsp chives, chopped - 1 tsp thyme - 1 tsp cayenne powder (adjust to heat preference  - 1/2 tsp red chili flakes - 1/2 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste  Instructions  - Toss cubed steak with oil, Worcestershire, garlic powder, and a generous amount of salt & pepper. Set aside while the pan heats. - Heat a skillet over medium heat with a little oil or butter. - Add onions, sugar, and salt. Cook 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft, golden, and jammy. Remove from pan and set aside. - Crank heat to medium-high/high. Add steak in a single layer (work in batches if needed). - Sear 2–3 minutes per side until deeply browned. Remove and set aside. Lower heat to medium. - Add butter to the same pan. Once melted, add garlic and shallot — cook ~30 seconds until fragrant. - Stir in lemon juice, Dijon, parsley, chives, thyme, cayenne, chili flakes, smoked paprika, and salt. - Add steak back to the pan. - Toss to coat in the butter sauce for 1–2 minutes. - Serve over creamy mashed potatoes and enjoy! • • • #recipe #steak #dinnerideas #food #steak

d: Lemon garlic salmon pasta ✨🍋 Ingredients  Salmon - 4 salmon fillets - 1 tsp kinder’s lemon garlic butter seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic powder  - 1 tsp paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - Salt and pepper to taste - 1 tbsp butter - 1 tbsp avocado oil  - 14 oz fettuccine  Cream sauce - 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream - 1/4 cup lemon juice - 1/4 cup pasta water - 1 lemon, zested - 3 tbsp butter  - 6 garlic cloves, minced - 2 shallot, finely chopped  - 1 cup Parmesan cheese  - 1 heaping tsp garlic powder  - 1 heaping tsp kinders lemon garlic butter sesoning - 1 tsp basil - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 - 1/2 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions - Bring a large pot of well-salted water to a boil. - Cook fettuccine according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain and set aside. - Pat salmon filets dry. - Rub with avocado oil, then season with paprika, garlic powder, oregano, kinders lemon garlic butter seasoning, salt, and pepper. - Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and butter. Sear salmon for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through, basting with the pan drippings. Remove and set aside. - In the same skillet, reduce heat to medium. Add butter and let melt. Sauté shallot for about 3 minutes until softened, then add garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant. - Stir in lemon juice and heavy cream. Let simmer for 2–3 minutes until slightly thickened, then add lemon zest. - Add seasonings and freshly grated Parmesan. Stir until smooth. Pour in reserved pasta water and mix until the sauce is well combined. Taste and adjust salt and pepper as needed. - Add cooked pasta to the skillet and toss until evenly coated in the sauce. - Garnish with fresh parsley and serve alongside the salmon. • • • #Recipe #DinnerIdeas #pasta #salmonrecipe #recipeideas

Homemade in n out burgers 🍔 ✨  Can you believe I’ve filmed this exact thing 6 times and I finally liked how it turned out 😭 Full recipe below ⬇️  Ingredients  Burgers - 1.5 pounds ground beef (80/20) - iceberg lettuce - tomatoes, sliced  - american cheese or sharp cheddar, slices  - brioche buns - Salt and pepper to taste caramelized onions - 2 large white onions, diced - 1 tbsp olive oil  - 2 tbsp butter - 1 tsp granulated sugar - 1/2 tsp salt sauce  - 1 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup ketchup  - 1/4 cup caramelized onions  - 2 tbsp pickles, finely chopped  - 1 tbsp yellow mustard  - 1 tsp distilled white vinegar  - 1 tsp sugar - 1/2 tsp salt  - 1/4 tsp black pepper  Instructions: - In a medium bowl, combine mayonnaise, mustard, ketchup, onions, pickles, salt, pepper, sugar, and vinegar together.  Cover and refrigerate while you prepare the rest. - Heat a small pan over low heat with 1 tbsp oil and butter. Cook onions slowly for 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft, golden brown, and sweet. Set aside. Burgers  - Divide the ground beef into 4 equal portions (about 100g each) - Roll each into a ball, then flatten into thin patties about 1/4-inch thick. (Wider than the bun – they'll shrink.) - Season one side generously with salt and pepper. Keep chilled until ready to cook. Buns  - Cut the buns in half - Lightly butter the cut sides. - Toast them cut-side down in a dry skillet or griddle over medium heat until golden and crispy. Remove and set aside. Cook the Burger Patties - Heat a skillet or griddle over medium-high heat. Add a thin layer of oil. - Add patties (2 at a time, don’t overcrowd).  - Cook for 2 minutes on the first side until browned. Add mustard and spread evenly. - Flip and immediately add a slice of American cheese to each patty. - Cook for another 1–2 minutes, until cheese is melted and the patty is cooked through. - Assemble burger with sauce, desired toppings, and enjoy!  • • • #burgers #recipe #innoutburger #recipeideas #food #cooking #dinnerideas

d: My Wife Has Been Begging Me To Make This… Loaded Potato Soup 4 large Russet potatoes cleaned 4 tbsps butter 2 tbsps garlic 1/2 chopped yellow onion 1/2 cup Flour 3 cups Milk 4 cups chicken stock (divided in half) Salt, pepper, and garlic powder to taste 1/2 cup sour cream 16 oz velvetta cubbed 3-6 crumbled strips of bacon Optional*** Garnish with bacon and green onion Poke holes in the potatoes with a fork, microwave them for 12 to 15 minutes until tender. Halve the potatoes and cut into chunks to cool In a large pot, melt butter over medium-low heat.  Add garlic and onion and cook until the onion is translucent Slowly whisk the flour into the pan and stir til slightly browned.  Slowly whisk in the milk 1 cup at a time. Then add the 1/2 chicken stock. Bring to a light simmer and whisk in the salt, garlic powder and pepper. Let come to a light simmer and thicken stirring occasionally  Add velvetta, bacon and the sour cream and stir til smooth Turn off heat, and fold in potatoes  I garnish with green onion and a little bacon and my wife LOVES IT, good luck!  Ps: I use half the chicken stock when I cook the soup and when I put it away for leftovers I add the additional 2cups to thin it out…. d: Loaded Baked Potato Soup🥔 #soup #potato #potatoes #recipes #recipesforyou  Start out by chopping up 1 pound of bacon and cook it in a pot on medium heat.  Cook it until it’s nice and crispy and set it aside on a paper towel.  Remove some of the bacon grease from the pot leaving about 3 to 4 tablespoons in there.  Then add: -1 cup of diced onion -1 tablespoon of minced garlic Cook until the onions run clear and then add: -4 tablespoons of butter  Then once the butter is melted add: -1/3 cup of flour  And whisk it all together until smooth  Then slowly whisk in the following (slowly and a little bit at a time): -2 cups of 2% milk -1 cup of heavy whipping cream  -1/2 cup of sour cream  -3 cups of chicken broth  Once it comes to a simmer add: -4 cups worth of cooked and peeled potatoes. (I’m using the insides of the potato skins I made in my last video, but you can just boil and chop up some potatoes or bake some in the oven.)  Season to taste with: -chicken bouillon powder  -paprika -and salt and pepper Then add: -1 cup of freshly shredded cheddar cheese  -the majority of your crispy bacon (make sure to save a little for garnishing.)   Then serve once the cheese melts and top it off with: -a little more cheese -your bacon  -chives or green onion  -a dollop of sour cream  Enjoy💜

d: Roasted garlic au gratin potatoes, perfect side for the holidays if you don’t want to make mac & cheese! Full recipe below   Ingredients  - 8 russet potatoes, thinly sliced - 1/2 medium onion, diced - 2 garlic heads, roasted  - 4 oz pancetta - 2 tbsp butter - 3 tbsp flour  - 2 cups half and half - 7 oz guyere cheese, shredded  - 7 oz smoked Gouda, shredded  - 7 oz montamore cheddar, shredded (or Parmesan) - 1 tsp garlic powder (add more or less for all seasonings) - 1 tsp onion powder - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp dried thyme  - Salt and pepper to taste Instructions  Instructions: - Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) - Slice the top off the garlic bulb, drizzle with olive oil, season with salt & pepper, wrap in foil, and roast for about 40 minutes until soft and caramelized. Once cooled, squeeze the roasted garlic out of the cloves and mash it with a fork. Set aside. - Wash and peel the potatoes. Slice them thinly (about 1/8-inch thick). Place the sliced potatoes in a bowl of cold water to prevent browning. - In a saucepan,on medium heat add pancetta. Cook until slightly crispy then remove from pan.  - Add butter to remaining grease from pancetta, diced onions, and sauté until translucent. Add flour and whisk until flour is cooked. - Pour in the half and half, stirring to combine. Add roasted garlic paste, mix until combined. Bring to a simmer, add seasonings, and cook for 10-15 minutes.  - Stir in the cheeses until melted and smooth. Season with salt and pepper to taste. - Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with butter or cooking spray. Layer the sliced potatoes evenly in the dish, slightly overlapping. Pour the creamy sauce over the potatoes and spread to make sure it evenly coated  - Cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil and bake 320F (160C) for 50-90 minutes, until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork. - Remove the foil and bake uncovered on broil for 3-5 minutes or until top is golden and bubbly  • • #recipes #augratin #scallopedpotatoes #dinnerideas #fyp  #creatorsearchinsights

d: Replying to @8obby1 This recipe is too good not to share! Craving it again as I was editing it 🥹 ➡️ Recipe: Mongolian beef  Serves 3-4 - [ ] 1 lb beef flank, sliced into 2 inch pieces  - [ ] 1 large onion, 1/4 inch slices  - [ ] 4-5 green onion stalks, 2-3 inch pieces - [ ] 4-5 cloves garlic, finely minced  - [ ] 1 tsp ginger, grated  - [ ] Optional: 4-7 Dried chilies for spice  Marinade- - [ ] 3 tbsp cornstarch  - [ ] 1/4 tsp baking soda - [ ] 1 tbsp shao xing wine (dry sherry or dry white wine is fine) - [ ] 1/2 tbsp soy sauce  - [ ] 1/2 tbsp dark soy sauce  - [ ] 1/4 tsp ground white pepper  Sauce-  - [ ] 1 tbsp oyster sauce  - [ ] 1/2 tbsp dark soy sauce  - [ ] 1/2 tbsp soy sauce  - [ ] 2 tsp sugar  - [ ] 1 tsp chicken bouillon  - [ ] 1 tsp Sesame oil, or to taste  - [ ] 1/2 tsp white or black pepper  - [ ] 1/3 cup Cooking oil, for shallow fry - [ ] Steamed rice, to serve 1. Marinate sliced beef with cornstarch, baking soda, shao xing wine, soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and white pepper. Mix well and marinade for 15 mins.  2. To make the sauce, combine oyster sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar, chicken bouillon, white pepper, and sesame oil. Set aside 3. Heat a wok with 1/3 cup of oil (use more or less if you want). Ensure oil is hot, then add in marinated beef. Spread out evenly and leave it to cook for 2-3 mins on each side for a nice crust.  4. Once beef is 90% cooked through, strain the beef from oil and set it aside.  5. Leave 2-3 tablespoons of oil in wok and add ginger, garlic and dried chillies. Cook until fragrant.  6. Add in onions and cook for 2-3 mins or until barely translucent.  7. Add in beef along with the sauce and toss evenly. (2 mins)  8. Top with green onions and toss one last time.  9. Serve with steamed rice or by itself. Enjoy!  #mongolianbeef #takeout #chinesefood #asianrecipe #easyrecipe

Recipe Name Creamy Garlic Parmesan Steak Ingredients 1. 4 ribeye or sirloin steaks 2. 2 tbsp olive oil 3. 2 tbsp butter 4. 4 cloves garlic, minced 5. 1 cup heavy cream 6. 1/2 cup beef broth 7. 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese 8. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 9. 1/2 tsp paprika 10. 1 tsp black pepper 11. 1 tsp salt 12. 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 13. 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Season the steaks with salt, pepper, and paprika. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet over high heat. 3. Sear the steaks for 3–5 minutes per side until cooked to your liking. 4. Remove the steaks and let them rest. 5. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the garlic until fragrant. 6. Add the beef broth and Dijon mustard, stirring well. 7. d: New York Times Top 50 Recipes of 2025 | Smashed Beef Kabob with Cucumber Yogurt @nytcooking @zaynab_issa - 2 cups Greek yogurt - 2 mini cucumbers - 3 tbsp mint - 1 large garlic clove - 1 pound ground beef (80/20) - 1 small yellow onion - ½ tsp ground turmeric - 2 tsp salt - black pepper - ¼ cup walnut halves - 2 tbsp cranberries - Pomegranate molasses, optional, for serving - Warmed pita or white rice, for serving Combine the yogurt, cucumbers, chopped mint, and garlic in a medium bowl, mix well, and chill until ready to serve. In a separate bowl, thoroughly mix the beef, onion, turmeric, 1 teaspoon of salt, and plenty of black pepper. Heat a large, well-seasoned cast-iron skillet over medium-high until very hot, then drop the beef into the pan in large, irregular chunks, cooking undisturbed for 6 to 8 minutes until charred and crisp on the bottom. Toss the meat with a wooden spoon to break up any extra-large pieces, then stir in the walnuts and raisins, cooking for another 2 to 3 minutes until the meat is done and the walnuts are toasted. Finally, season the chilled yogurt with the remaining 1 teaspoon of salt, spread it across the bottom of a serving platter, layer the crispy meat on top, and finish with a drizzle of optional pomegranate molasses, fresh mint leaves, and a side of warmed pita or rice. #kabob #FoodTok #nyt #cooking #beef

The perfect recipe to satisfy your takeout craving 😋 ➡️ Recipe: Beijing Beef  Serves 3-4 * 1lb skirt steak or flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain  * 1 small red bell pepper, large diced  * 1 medium onion, large diced  * 4-5 garlic cloves, finely minced  * 1 tsp grated ginger  * Frying oil  Beef marinade— * 1/2 cup cornstarch  * 2 tbsp water (add an extra 1/2tbsp if needed  * 1 tsp sesame oil  * 1/2 tsp garlic powder * 1/4 tsp baking soda  * 1/4 tsp kosher salt  * 1/8 tsp white or black pepper  Sauce— * 3 tbsp rice vinegar or 2 tbsp white vinegar  * 2 tbsp oyster sauce  * 2 tbsp ketchup  * 1 tbsp hoisin sauce  * 1 1/2 tbsp soy sauce  * 1 1/2 tbsp sugar  * 1/2-1 tsp chili flakes (optional)  1. In a bowl, combine sesame, oil, garlic powder, baking soda, kosher salt, and white pepper with flank steak. Mix well then add cornstarch and water, mix until the meat is craggly and set aside.  2. In a small bowl, combine vinegar, oyster sauce, ketchup, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and chili flakes. Mix well and set aside.  3. In a large pan, heat enough oil for a shallow fry to 350°F. Carefully place marinated beef to fry and ensure each slice does not stick together for an even fry. Fry for 3-4 mins or until beef is cooked through and coated and crispy. Strain the beef and set aside. 4. In a large wok, heat 1-2 tbsp oil. Add onions and bell peppers sauté for 30 seconds or just before it turns translucent. Then add garlic and ginger and sauté for another 30 secs-1 min. 5. Make a pit in the center and pour all of the sauce. Toss with onions and bell peppers for about. Then add the fried beef. Braised Chicken Legs with Rice, Potatoes & Veggies🍗 Ingredients * 1 package chicken drumsticks (6–7 pieces) * 1-2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp salt * 1 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp garlic powder * 2 tsp onion powder * 2 tsp paprika * ½ tsp cumin * 1 jalapeño, diced * ½ red onion, diced * 1 tbsp sun-dried tomato paste * 1 tbsp @Loisa sofrito * 5–6 garlic cloves, minced * 4 cups chicken stock * 1 (8 oz) can tomato sauce * Small potatoes, halved (about 10–12 baby potatoes) * 1 zucchini, diced * Cooked white rice, for serving (let me know if you guys want my rice recipe) Instructions: 1. Clean the chicken with vinegar, then pat completely dry with paper towels. 2. Season the chicken with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and cumin. Toss until evenly coated. 3. Return the chicken to the pot. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 1 hour, or until the chicken is fall-apart tender and the sauce has reduced. 10. About 20 minutes before the chicken is done, add the halved potatoes and diced zucchini. Continue simmering until the potatoes are fork-tender and the zucchini is cooked. 11. Japan's most famous Katsudon🍚  If you’ve never had this, you are missing out on one of Japan’s greatest masterpieces. It’s a crispy, golden pork cutlet (Tonkatsu) simmered in a sweet and savory dashi broth with tender onions and silky, marbled eggs—all piled high on a steaming bowl of rice. It’s crunchy, juicy, sweet, savory, and pure perfection in every single bite! 🛒 The Ingredients The Crunch: Pork loin chop breaded in crispy Japanese Panko. The Umami Broth: Dashi stock, soy sauce, mirin, and a pinch of sugar. The Topping: Thinly sliced yellow onions and lightly beaten eggs. The Base: Steamed Japanese short-grain rice. 🍳 How It’s Made (The Process) Fry: Season and coat the pork in flour, egg, and panko. Deep fry until golden brown and slice it up. Simmer: Cook the onions in the savory dashi broth until tender. Assemble: Lay the crispy katsu right on top of the onions, pour the swirled eggs around it, and cover until softly set. Slide: Slide the whole glorious thing over a hot bed of rice and garnish with green onions! #japanesefood #japan #katsudon#tonkatsu #donburi#cooking #ricebowl #cookingtiktok #asmrfood #food #foodie #wokkings #fypシ #viral

Worth It? 👀🇳🇬 ₦5,000 (US$3) Nigerian Street Food in Lagos. I stopped at a busy roadside food stall on Allen Avenue in Lagos to see what a ₦5,000 meal gets you in Nigeria. All the food is displayed on the side of the road. They had everything from giant fish to jollof rice, coconut rice, fried chicken and sweet plantains. I skipped the mystery fish 😅 and went for chicken, coconut rice and plantains instead. The verdict? The plantains were delicious, the chicken was a little tough and cold, and the coconut rice tasted a bit fishy for my liking. Considering the price, I’d still give it a 7/10 just because the people were really nice and friendly. One thing to keep in mind: this is real roadside street food. If hygiene is your top priority, this probably isn’t your scene. But if you love experiencing authentic local Nigerian food in Lagos, it’s definitely an interesting stop. ❤️🇳🇬 #nigeria #streefood #lagos

d: For 8 yuan ($1 USD) in China, I got a full kilogram of Jiang Xiang Bing  (酱香饼). The dough is flattened so wide that it folds onto itself while  baking, creating layers of texture. After five minutes in the oven, a  sweet fermented wheat sauce is brushed over the top. The folds soak up  the sauce, locking in extra flavor. Sesame seeds and scallions are  sprinkled as the finishing touch. The result is a fluffy, chewy bread  with a perfect balance of sweet and savory.   #China #Food #Travel #ChineseFood #ChinaFood #StreetFood

d: This game turns a gas station night shift into co-op doppelganger horror 🎮 Shift At Midnight 🗓️ Out Now 👥 1-3 Players 🖥️ PC (Steam) Part co-op horror game and part Papers, Please-style doppelganger check, this game has you running a lonely gas station, questioning customers, checking IDs, and deciding who needs to die before they walk back in as something worse. d: Build a survival train that becomes your whole moving colony 🎮 Railborn 🗓️ Wishlist Now 👥 1-4 Players 🖥️ PC (Steam) A first-person survival crafting game where you build a train into a rolling base, manage power and water, and keep pushing down branching tracks. d: Hearing your cat scream is the most heartbreaking noise in the world. When Luna started screaming like this we went to the vet to rule everything medical out and they said she’s healthy (minus stage two kidney disease), but this is what senior cat dementia looks like. She will get lost in our small apartment. She will yell. A LOT. Her memory isnt all there anymore, though we swear she knows exactly what time it is all day long. Give your senior cats extra comfort, extra love, extra patience for those 6am cat screaming sessions, and remember that one day youd give anything to hear these screams again. This is the sad side of growing older your babies.. but how lucky am I to be the one to hug her and always make sure she knows I’d climb to the moon to make her feel okay. 🥹❤️‍🩹 #cat #cats #seniorcatsoftiktok #dementia #catlover
zh: 听到猫咪嚎叫是世界上最令人心碎的声音。Luna开始这样叫的时候，我们带她去看了兽医排除所有身体问题，医生说她身体健康（除了二期肾病）。这就是老年猫痴呆的样子——她会在我们小小的公寓里迷路，会大声嚎叫，记忆已大不如前，但我们发誓她对每天的时间还是了如指掌。请给你的老年猫多一些安慰、多一些爱、多一些耐心，去陪伴那些清晨六点的嚎叫时光，并记住：总有一天你会多想再听到这声音。这是毛孩子慢慢老去的悲伤一面……但能够拥抱她、让她知道我愿意为她翻山越岭，我是多么幸运。

d: Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking
