d: Mac n cheese with garlic butter steak bites 🤤 RECIPE⬇️ Mac n cheese: * 12 oz pasta * Chicken bouillon (for boiling pasta) * 10 oz sharp white cheddar * 8 oz Colby Jack * 5-6 oz Mozzarella  * 2 oz Parmesan * 3 tbs butter * 3 tbs flour * 1 cup heavy cream (1.5 if you prefer saucier) * 1 12-oz can evaporated milk * 1 tsp Dijon mustard * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp paprika * Salt and pepper to taste Garlic butter steak bites: * 1 lb steak, cut into bite size cubes  * 1 tsp each: garlic powder, smoked paprika, Worcestershire * 1/2 tsp Montreal steak seasoning * 1/2 tsp dried thyme * Drizzle of oil  * Salt and pepper to taste * 1/2 stick butter * 1/4 small shallot, minced * 4-5 garlic cloves, minced * Optional: chopped parsley for garnish 1. In a bowl, mix the steak with some oil and all the seasonings. Let that marinate while you prep the mac. 2. Shred cheeses and mix together. Set aside. 3. Boil pasta in water that has been generously seasoned with chicken bouillon or salt until al dente, 1-2 min below box instructions. 4. Melt butter and bloom the spices - garlic powder, paprika - for 1 min. Then add the flour and cook for a 1-2 mins. 5. While whisking, slowly add in the heavy cream and evaporated milk. Whisk until smooth.  6. Once the mixture warms up again (but NOT simmering) turn off the heat and stir in half of your cheese mixture in batches until combined. 7. Layer in a baking dish, starting with half the mac mixture, half of the leftover cheese, the rest of the mac, and finally the rest of the cheese. Sprinkle some paprika on top for color. 8. Bake at 375F for 25-30 min until golden. Broil on low for a few min for more crust if desired. 9. While the mac is baking, add oil to a pan and sear the steak until desired doneness and it develops a nice crust. 10. 1 min before the steak is done, add 1/2 stick butter, garlic, and shallots and cook for the remaining time. 11. When mac is done baking, rest 10 min before serving and top with the steak bites. #macandcheese #steakbites #garlicbutter #creamypasta

d: im all for cheesy pasta but sometimes my stomach needs a break #nextlevelchef #nextleveldish #pasta #recipe #healthy #fyp  RECIPE Fake Alfredo Pasta 4 servings any pasta 2 cups reserved pasta water 1 16 oz package silken tofu 1 14 oz can artichoke hearts 3 oz boursin cheese (optional) 1 Tbsp miso (optional) 4 cloves garlic 2 tsp kosher salt 1 tsp red chili flakes 1 tsp dried oregano  Fresh ground black pepper Fried olive topping 3 Tbsp olive oil 1 cup castelvetrano olives, chopped 1 cup panko breadcrumbs Cook pasta al dente in salted water according to package instructions and reserve 1-2 cups of the pasta water before draining and setting cooked pasta aside. In a separate large skillet, fry the chopped olives in olive oil on medium high heat for 3-5 minutes. Add the breadcrumbs and a Tbsp more olive oil and toss to fry for another 5 minutes. Blend 1/4 cup pasta water, silken tofu, drained artichoke hearts, boursin cheese, miso, garlic, salt, chili flakes, oregano, and black pepper in a blender or food processor. Do not add more salt before mixing the sauce with pasta! Add the sauce to the strained pot of pasta. Add ½ cup of the reserved pasta water and toss pasta and sauce together on medium low heat, allowing the sauce to bind to the pasta for at least 5-7 minutes. Continue adding splashes of pasta water while the sauce gets glossy and thickens. Taste the sauce and adjust any seasonings to your preference.   Divide and serve pasta with generous helpings of fried olive and breadcrumb topping <3

zh: 我爱芝士意面，但有时候胃受不了——食谱：假版阿尔弗雷多意面，4人份，所需食材：任意意面、2杯面汤备用水、1包嫩豆腐（16盎司）、1罐洋蓟心（14盎司）、布尔森奶酪（可选）、味噌（可选）、4瓣大蒜、2茶匙盐、1茶匙红辣椒片、1茶匙干牛至、现磨黑胡椒。油炸橄榄配料：3汤匙橄榄油、1杯卡斯特尔韦特拉诺橄榄（切碎）、1杯日式面包糠。按包装说明将意面在盐水中煮至弹牙，沥水前留1-2杯面汤备用。另起大平底锅，用中大火将切碎橄榄在橄榄油中煎3-5分钟，加入面包糠和少量橄榄油翻炒5分钟。将1/4杯面汤、嫩豆腐、沥干的洋蓟心、布尔森奶酪、味噌、大蒜、盐、辣椒片、牛至和黑胡椒放入搅拌机打匀，拌入意面前勿再加盐。将酱汁倒入沥干的意面锅中，加半杯备用面汤，中小火翻拌5-7分钟使酱汁裹匀面条，期间不断加入少量面汤直至酱汁光亮浓稠，调味后分盛，撒上大量炸橄榄面包糠配料即可。

d: Recipe Name Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Breast Ingredients 1. 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts 2. 2 tbsp olive oil 3. 2 tbsp butter 4. 4 garlic cloves, minced 5. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 6. 1 tsp paprika 7. 1 tsp salt 8. 1/2 tsp black pepper 9. 1 cup heavy cream 10. 1/2 cup chicken broth 11. 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1 tsp garlic powder 13. 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Sear the chicken for 5–6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. 4. Remove the chicken and keep warm. 5. Melt the butter in the same pan. 6. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream, stirring well. 8. Add Parmesan cheese and cook until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. 10. Simmer for 3–5 minutes so the flavors combine. 11. Garnish with fresh parsley. 12. Serve with mashed potatoes, pasta, or roasted vegetables. Follow for more delicious recipes!

Steak & Eggs, cooked entirely in a cast iron pan on my balcony. There’s something about a hot cast iron, a ribeye, crispy potatoes, and eggs that just feels right. Ingredients: * 1 ribeye steak * Salt & black pepper * 3 Yukon Gold potatoes, cut into large chunks * 1 onion, julienned * 3 eggs * 1 tbsp neutral oil Cowboy Butter: * 1 stick (½ cup) butter, melted * 2 cloves garlic, minced * 2 tbsp chopped parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes * ½ tsp Cajun seasoning * ½ tsp cayenne pepper * Salt & black pepper, to taste Method: 1. Preheat a cast iron pan in a 500°F pizza oven (or any very hot oven). Add the neutral oil and sear the ribeye until medium-rare to medium. Remove and let it rest. 2. Add the onion and cook until deeply golden. Stir in the potatoes and roast until they’re tender with crispy edges. 3. Push the potatoes to the outside of the pan, leaving a circle in the center. Crack in the 3 eggs. 4. Slice the rested steak. Pour in the cowboy butter, add the steak back to the pan, and let everything sizzle until the eggs are cooked to your liking. 5. Serve immediately and spoon that cowboy butter over everything. #steakandeggs #easyrecipes #ribeye #torontofood

Honey Chipotle Fried Chicken 🍯🌶️ I have a witness to confirm that this story is real 😂 This is how I make super crispy Honey Chipotle Fried Chicken at home with a spicy + sweet glaze and a delicious Comeback Sauce to dip the chicken in 😋 👉 Full detailed recipes in bio 🔗 — Marinade (overnight / 4+ hrs): Buttermilk, eggs, pickle juice, adobo sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, pepper, mustard powder, salt, MSG. Marinate thighs + drumsticks overnight. Comeback Sauce: @Kewpieusa mayo, ketchup, Dijon, Worcestershire, hot sauce, lemon juice, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, minced pickles, honey, S&P. Mix & chill in the fridge. FULL RECIPE + VIDEO COMING SOON 🔥 Seasoned Flour: AP Flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt + same dry seasonings as marinade. Mix 2-3 tbsp marinade into the flour for crispy craggly bits. Double Dredge: Marinade → flour (press & squeeze) → marinade → flour (press & squeeze). Fry: 350°F oil until golden brown + CWISPY & 165°F internal. Drumsticks: ~10–12 min. Thighs: ~6–8 min Honey Chipotle Glaze: Honey, adobo sauce, brown sugar, water. Simmer until smooth + glossy → add grated garlic → remove from heat → finish with lime juice + salt. Toss (or brush) chicken in glaze. Garnish: Garnish with sesame seeds, chives/green onions, and whatever else you want. Serve with comeback sauce and enjoy, friends :)  — #friedchickenrecipe #comebacksauce #honeychipotle #friedchicken

I got this recipe from a lady at the market here in Puglia🧺🇮🇹 I noticed every stand was loaded with green beans so I asked one of the ladies what she was going to make with them. She told me about this pasta & insisted the green beans cook right in the same pot as the pasta… I could have sworn she said to add in a lot of cheese😂 This is the kind of pasta you’ll find in Italian homes all summer long! Ingredients: 1 lb  spaghetti or thick spaghetti  1/2 lb green beans, trimmed 1 lb cherry tomatoes, halved 4 cloves garlic 1 small chili pepper, chopped  Fresh basil Olive oil Salt Pecorino Romano Instructions: 1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the green beans and the spaghetti to the same pot and cook until al dente. 2. Meanwhile, heat a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil in a large pan. Add the garlic, chili pepper, and a few basil leaves. Cook until fragrant.  3. Add the cherry tomatoes, season with salt, and cook until they begin to soften.  4. Transfer the spaghetti and green beans directly to the pan along with a splash of pasta water. Toss everything together until the sauce lightly coats the pasta. 5. Turn off the heat and stir in a generous amount of freshly grated Pecorino Romano until creamy. #pasta #italianfood #fyp
